notes: Bear is a generic brown bear drawn by Jane Chapman; standard Boardmaker bear icon matches well enough for classroom use. The story centres on Bear waking from hibernation in spring, foraging and eating with friends, and never feeling full — so hunger/fullness vocabulary is central. 'More' is already a fixed core word (Row 2) and does not need a fringe slot. Several words (hungry, eat, berries, honey, cave, spring, wake up, friends) already exist in the provided activity_images or aac_extras data and can be reused directly. 'Food' and 'grass' are new additions. 'Full' is the key emotional/physical payoff of the story and should be included even though it is slightly abstract — pair with a stomach/tummy image for clarity.
